ruleDefinitions.name: Automated Collection Bookmarks Using Get-ChildItem PowerShell
ruleDefinitions.description:
Adversaries may enumerate browser bookmarks to learn more about compromised hosts.
Browser bookmarks may reveal personal information about users (ex: banking sites, interests, social media, etc.) as well as details about
internal network resources such as servers, tools/dashboards, or other related infrastructure.
 Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-ChildItem.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-Recurse\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-Path\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-Filter\\ Bookmarks.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-ErrorAction\\ SilentlyContinue.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-Force.*"))
